literal_meaning: কেউটে ধরা (scorpion-এ ধরা or caught by a scorpion)
figurative_meaning_en: Engaging in dangerous or risky actions
similar_in_english: Dancing on the edge of a volcano
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে কেউটে ধরার মতো বিপজ্জনক স্থানে যাচ্ছে।
এই ব্যবসা করা কেউটে ধরার সমান।
example_sentences_in_english: He is heading to a place as dangerous as catching a scorpion.
Doing this business is like catching a scorpion.
note: The idiom draws from the natural fear of scorpions in rural Bengal, emphasizing peril in common parlance.
